mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , 'K20' AS tr_cd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.MG_CD AS tr_co_cd , t1.TRUSTEE AS trustee , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , 0 AS bs_type , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , ya.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , ya.JM_NM AS jm_nm , (NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.MSD_MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(t1.MSD_MEDO_AEKM, 0)) AS tr_jusu , 0 AS tr_danga , 0 AS tr_cost , 0 AS tr_tax , 0 AS tr_aek , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd , 0 AS gyulje_aek , 1 AS p_visible FROM SYM0YZ t1 , SYM0YA ya , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ya.JASAN_GB = '1' AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND ia.CORP_GR(+) = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD(+) = t1.FUND_CD AND (NVL(t1.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(t1.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) + NVL(t1.MSD_MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(t1.MSD_MEDO_AEKM, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY t1.JM_CD ASC
SELECT t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , t1.CURRENCY AS currency FROM SYM0YA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND ROWNUM = 1
